name: Zoom Rooms
description: Zoom Rooms provides software-based meeting-room systems for conferencing, wireless sharing, device management, calendars, signage, and room control.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Server-to-Server OAuth app with one granular list scope, then inspect one bounded page of anonymous Zoom Rooms fleet-health metadata.

capabilities.label: Read anonymous fleet health
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded Zoom Rooms availability and type metadata without room identity or controls.

approvalRequired.label: List room fleet health
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of anonymous Zoom Rooms status and type metadata.

blocked.label: Room identity
blocked.description: Room names, activation codes, room/location/user/calendar IDs, tag IDs, device IDs, IP addresses, serials, MAC addresses, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: Room controls
blocked.description: Meeting start, join, invite, leave, end, mute, unmute, restart, shutdown, signage, alerts, and other room controls are not exposed.

blocked.label: Settings and content
blocked.description: Meeting and phone passwords, calendars, device profiles, room settings, sensor data, recordings, participants, content, and communications data are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Room, device, location, tag, calendar, app, firmware, settings, and E911 changes plus arbitrary paths, filters, cursors, origins, and raw tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every organization-wide Zoom Rooms fleet-health read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected anonymous fleet reads run without Relay per-action approval while fixed origins, endpoint, bound, redaction, audit, scope, account roles, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware anonymous Zoom Rooms fleet tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware anonymous Zoom Rooms fleet tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer administrator must create and activate a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only zoom_rooms:read:list_rooms:admin and provide encrypted credentials; a Zoom Rooms license is also required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the dedicated customer app and Railway credentials, verify licensing and account role, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify renewal/revocation, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Zoom documents GET /v2/rooms, a bounded page size, room status/type fields, the Zoom Rooms license prerequisite, and separate control and administration APIs.
Zoom maps List Zoom Rooms to zoom_rooms:read:list_rooms:admin and separates profile, device, location, settings, calendar, sensor, tag, control, and mutation scopes.
Zoom added meeting and phone password fields to settings endpoints in March 2026; Relay excludes all room-settings and credential surfaces.
